import {test, expect} from 'vitest';
import {accepts, firstIndex, reference} from './src/value';

test('short input remains valid', () => expect(accepts('')).toBe(true));
test('excess input is rejected', () => expect(accepts('x'.repeat(9))).toBe(false));
test('duplicate references keep the first index', () => expect(firstIndex([{kind:'notice',ref:'a'},{kind:'notice',ref:'a'}], 'a')).toBe(0));
test('null has no reference', () => expect(reference(null)).toBeUndefined());
test('a numeric reference is rejected', () => expect(reference({ref:42})).toBeUndefined());
